_comment: Hand-maintained. Kept apart from perf-baseline-mobile.json because that file is regenerated with `--record-mobile-baseline ... > file`, which would erase anything written into it. Every entry needs allowanceKb and a reason; each is ratcheted at the measured First Load JS + ~5 kB so further growth fails CI.

/app.reason: Measured 160 kB on 2026-10-22 (baseline 105 kB, +55). Home gained the KPI strip, alert carousel, pull-to-refresh, KPI sheets and the offline snapshot across PRs 3-6. The user-facing gate passes on production (Home KPIs visible within 2.5 s on Slow 4G + 4x CPU, perf.spec.ts), so the overage is accepted for now. Ratcheted at measured + 5 kB. What dominates the extra bytes has not been analysed.

/app/chat.reason: Measured 154 kB on 2026-10-22 (baseline 106 kB, +48). Chat was rebuilt in PR 6 (history, plan cards, receipt cards, composer, formatter, keyboard hooks). Home's Slow-4G gate passes and chat has no timing gate of its own yet. Ratcheted at measured + 4 kB. What dominates the extra bytes has not been analysed.
